insurance-consultation-checklist.pdf.title:
Insurance Consultation
Preparation Checklist
insurance-consultation-checklist.pdf.intro: Organize the coverage information, priorities, and questions that may be useful before your consultation. You do not need every item before contacting Alchemize.

pages.label: 01 / YOUR SITUATION
pages.heading: Start with what is changing and what you want to protect.

sections.title: About your situation
items: Upcoming life changes that may affect protection needs

prompts: Coverage I want to understand better

pages.label: 02 / QUESTIONS
pages.heading: Use the conversation to understand the protection in practical terms.

sections.title: Questions to ask
items: What costs am I responsible for?
What could cause premiums or benefits to change?
What happens if I need to use the coverage?

insurance-consultation-checklist.pdf.disclaimer: Coverage availability, eligibility, terms, pricing, and underwriting depend on applicable products, carriers, jurisdiction, and individual circumstances.

business-formation-startup-checklist.pdf.title:
Business Formation & Startup
Checklist
business-formation-startup-checklist.pdf.intro: Organize the decisions, records, and operating foundations involved in starting a business. You do not need every answer before contacting Alchemize.

pages.label: 01 / ESTABLISH THE BUSINESS
pages.heading: Clarify the business identity, ownership, and formation information.

sections.title: Business identity
items: Alternate or DBA names being considered
State where the business will be formed

sections.title: Formation preparation
items: Ownership or organizational agreements to discuss with qualified counsel

sections.title: Federal / tax identity
items: Tax-classification questions for an appropriate tax professional
Prior federal business registrations, if applicable

pages.label: 02 / PREPARE TO OPERATE
pages.heading: Build the practical infrastructure that supports the launch.

sections.title: Operational foundation
items: Contracts or templates needing qualified review

business-formation-startup-checklist.pdf.disclaimer: This checklist provides general organizational guidance and is not legal advice. Formation, tax, licensing, and other requirements vary by business and jurisdiction.

business-operations-organization-checkli.title:
Business Operations
Organization Checklist
business-operations-organization-checkli.intro: Use this operational review to identify scattered records, recurring responsibilities, and processes that need clearer ownership. It is a starting point, not a requirement to solve everything first.

pages.label: 01 / RECORDS & RESPONSIBILITIES
pages.heading: Create a dependable home for the records behind the business.

sections.title: Financial & tax records
items: Tax returns, notices, and estimated-payment records
Payroll or contractor records, where applicable

pages.label: 02 / WORKFLOWS & CONTROL
pages.heading: Document how recurring work moves—and who is responsible.
prompts: The process creating the most friction
The responsibility most likely to be missed
The system I most need to organize

business-operations-organization-checkli.disclaimer: This checklist is an organizational tool. Records, controls, retention requirements, and operational obligations vary by business and applicable requirements.
